name: Webnode
description_en:
Webnode is a hosted website builder for small-business sites, personal pages and online stores. Its current homepage describes generating an initial design from a business description, then editing and publishing with visual tools. Free websites can remain online, while premium packages add domain connection, capacity, email and plan-specific multilingual/member/backup tools.

Choose the lowest plan that actually covers the site’s behavior, not merely its domain. Limited and Mini do not remove branding in the observed table; Standard and Profi have materially different membership, language and recovery allowances. Public pricing was read in the rendered browser because the direct pricing response contained only a title.
description_zh:
Webnode 是面向小企业网站、个人页面和商店的托管建站工具。当前首页描述先按业务说明生成设计，再使用可视化工具编辑和发布。免费网站可持续在线，高级套餐增加域名连接、容量、邮件，以及按档区分的多语言/会员/备份工具。

应按实际站点行为而非仅域名选择最低合适方案。实读表中 Limited、Mini 不移除品牌，Standard 与 Profi 的会员、语言和恢复额度明显不同。直接定价响应只有标题，本次通过渲染浏览器实读价格。

core_features.name_zh: AI 草稿与可视化编辑
core_features.explanation_en: Describe the business, choose a generated design and customize content; check the draft rather than accepting claimed customer/traffic outcomes.
core_features.explanation_zh: 描述业务、选择生成设计并修改内容，应检查草稿，不能把厂商客户/流量描述当作结果。

core_features.explanation_en: Domain connection begins at Limited, while the observed table places branding removal and store support on Standard/Profi.
core_features.explanation_zh: Limited 起可连接域名，实读表将移除品牌和商店支持放在 Standard/Profi。

core_features.name_zh: 独立语言/会员/备份配额
core_features.explanation_en: Standard lists two languages, 100 members and five backups; Profi lists unlimited for these categories, with separate storage limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: Standard 列出两种语言、100 会员和五份备份，Profi 对这些类别列不限，但存储另有限额。

pricing.summary_en: Indefinite free site; observed Limited $4.50, Mini $8.50, Standard $12.90, Profi $22.90 monthly displays before tax, with promotional comparison rates. Billing toggle versus one-year FAQ conflict needs checkout confirmation.
pricing.summary_zh: 网站可持续免费；实读税前美元月费显示 Limited $4.50、Mini $8.50、Standard $12.90、Profi $22.90，并有优惠对比价。计费切换与一年期限 FAQ 差异需结账确认。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 先验证代表性小企业站
sections.en: The homepage’s flow is describe the site/business, choose a design, customize and publish. Start with the free address and a small set of service/contact pages, then inspect mobile navigation, generated facts, contact delivery and whether the editor exposes the controls you need. Free hosting and unlimited page count do not imply unlimited file storage, traffic or premium tools. The support portal distinguishes the current editor from a previous editor and has separate booking/invoicing integrations; do not infer every homepage business tool is native or included on every plan. No editor or generated website was operated in this research.
sections.zh: 首页流程为描述网站/业务、选设计、定制及发布。可先用免费地址和少量服务/联系页面，检查手机导航、生成事实、联系投递及编辑器是否提供所需控制。免费托管和页面数量不限不代表文件、流量或高级工具无限。支持门户区分当前与旧编辑器，并有独立预约/发票集成，不能推定首页全部业务工具均原生或每档包含。本次未操作编辑器或生成网站。

sections.title_en: Confirm billing term and promotion before paying
sections.title_zh: 付款前确认期限及优惠
sections.en: The observed USD before-tax page displays Limited $4.50/month; Mini discounted $8.50 versus $10.90; Standard $12.90 versus $18.50; Profi $22.90 versus $28.90. These are captured price pairs, not a confirmed renewal or universal country quote. The page has annual/monthly billing controls, while its expanded FAQ still says Premium minimum purchase is one year. Confirm the selected term, total upfront charge, renewal and whether the FAQ is current before treating a displayed monthly amount as a one-month contract. E-commerce plans are separately linked and were not fully priced here.
sections.zh: 实读税前美元页显示 Limited $4.50/月；Mini 优惠 $8.50、对比 $10.90；Standard $12.90、对比 $18.50；Profi $22.90、对比 $28.90。这是捕获的价对，不是确认续费价或所有国家通用报价。页面有年付/月付控制，但展开 FAQ 仍称 Premium 最短购买一年。将显示月费当作单月合同前，应确认选中期限、预收总额、续费及 FAQ 是否仍有效。电商方案有独立链接，本次未完整核价。

sections.title_en: Separate website storage, email and recovery
sections.title_zh: 区分网站存储、邮件和恢复
sections.en: In Limited/Mini/Standard/Profi order, the table lists site storage of 500MB/3GB/10GB/50GB and bandwidth of 1GB/3GB/10GB/unlimited. Limited supports one form field; Mini supports up to five. Mini has one email account, Standard 20 and Profi 100, with email storage reported separately from site storage. Standard adds two language versions, up to 100 registered members and five backups; Profi lists unlimited language/member/backup counts and site search. Standard/Profi remove branding, whereas Mini/Limited do not. Test membership access and a restore before depending on those quotas; a backup count is not evidence of an independently downloadable full site.
sections.zh: 按 Limited/Mini/Standard/Profi 顺序，站点存储为 500MB/3GB/10GB/50GB，带宽为 1GB/3GB/10GB/不限。Limited 支持一个表单字段，Mini 最多五个。Mini 含一个邮箱，Standard 20、Profi 100，邮件存储与站点存储分列。Standard 增加两种语言、最多 100 注册会员和五份备份；Profi 列语言/会员/备份数量不限并有站内搜索。Standard/Profi 移除品牌，Mini/Limited 不移除。依赖额度前应测试会员访问和恢复，备份数量不证明完整网站可独立下载。

sections.title_en: Claim the domain voucher and inspect refund exclusions
sections.title_zh: 领取域名券并核对退款排除
sections.en: The expanded pricing FAQ says Mini/Standard/Profi/Business include a one-year domain voucher emailed after purchase, valid 45 days; a free domain is not simply registered automatically without choosing/redeeming it. Limited excludes the voucher and allows manual DNS connection, while new registration or transfer costs extra. Card/PayPal customers can enable annual auto-renewal, with advance email notice and project-admin controls. The first Premium order has a 15-day refund window, excluding renewals, voucher-paid orders and domain registrations. Paid domain orders cannot be cancelled under that FAQ. Verify ongoing registration/email costs and do not confuse domain connection with an included domain purchase.
sections.zh: 展开定价 FAQ 称 Mini/Standard/Profi/Business 购买后邮件提供一年域名券，有效 45 天，免费域名并非无需选择/兑换就自动注册。Limited 不含券，可手动 DNS 连接，新注册或转入另付。银行卡/PayPal 用户可启用年度自动续费，提前邮件提醒，并在项目管理中控制。首次 Premium 订单有 15 天退款期，排除续费、代金券付款和域名注册；该 FAQ 称已付域名订单不能取消。应核对持续注册/邮件成本，连接域名不能混为包含购买域名。

sections.title_en: Preserve uncertainty around export and current support
sections.title_zh: 保留导出及当前支持中的未知
sections.en: Webnode may fit a small business that wants guided hosting and accepts the documented plan thresholds. Teams needing arbitrary source editing, own-server deployment, complete data export or migration between editor generations should obtain explicit current specifications. The sources read do not establish an open-source license or complete portable export. After reading the homepage, support index and rendered pricing/FAQs, a further official support request returned HTTP429; access to that origin was stopped, without bypassing it. This leaves detailed cancellation/retention and export procedures unverified. No account, payment, domain, booking, member access or backup recovery was tested.
sections.zh: 接受引导托管和方案门槛的小企业可考虑 Webnode。需要任意源码编辑、自有服务器部署、完整数据导出或跨编辑器代际迁移的团队应取得明确当前规范。实读来源未确立开源许可或完整可迁移导出。首页、支持目录和渲染定价/FAQ 读取后，进一步官方支持请求返回 HTTP429，已停止该来源访问，没有绕过。因此详细取消/保留和导出操作仍未核实。本次未实测账户、支付、域名、预约、会员访问或备份恢复。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Selected billing term, discount renewal, traffic reset period, free-tier quotas, current export/retention and paid FAQ details remain unverified; follow-up429 stopped access.
research_gaps.zh: 选中期限、折扣续费、流量重置周期、免费配额、当前导出/保留及付费 FAQ 细节未核实，后续429已停止访问。

research_gaps.en: No editor, domain-voucher redemption, premium transaction, multilingual/member workflow or backup restore was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行编辑器、域名券兑换、付费交易、多语言/会员流程或备份恢复。
